b64_mac_key.Description:
Base64-URL-encoded HS256 key. It is generated by the PublicCertificateAuthorityService
when the ExternalAccountKey is created.

key_id.Description: It is generated by the PublicCertificateAuthorityService when the ExternalAccountKey is created.

location.Description: Location for the externalAccountKey. Currently only 'global' is supported.
